content:
The other National Games ad can be placed in position 1, 2, or 3: 3 choices.

Then arrange the 2 distinct National Games ads in their two chosen positions: \(2!\) ways.  
Arrange the 3 distinct commercial ads in the remaining 3 positions: \(3!\) ways.

Total:
\[
3 \times 2! \times 3! = 3 \times 2 \times 6 = 36
\]

\boxed{36}
